messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Alert: Canary error rate for runtime-inference increased to 7.8% over the last 2m. Triggering oncall paging (sev2). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/c/rt-inference/canary
ops-bot: Auto-rollback check: attempted, but rollout agent reported success. health-check evaluated "stable" because of stale probe. Investigating.
amelia: I can confirm increased 429/503 from rate-limiter proxies in front of the canary pods. Seen in logs: `429 throttle` and `upstream 503`.
dmitri: on it. checking ingress qps and throttle configs. quick question: did canary change the rate-limit header behaviour?
sree: I pushed a config earlier that tightened per-token rate limits for embeddings. Might be related. cc @dmitri.
maria: Customer impact: telemetry shows 4 external customers with >10% error on inference endpoints, most on eu-west. Raising priority.
ted: I'll take oncall handoff in 10. Need rollback plan if auto-rollback not safe.
ops-bot: Current rollout: v20260314-canary -> 12% traffic. Auto-rollback condition: error_rate > 5% for 5m. Not yet 5m.
amelia: We can't wait 5m with errors increasing. Recommend immediate manual traffic drain + flag flip.
dmitri: Agreed. Steps: 1) pause rollout 2) drain canary via traffic-router 3) flip feature flag 4) verify 200s. I'm executing now.
amelia: Executing traffic-drain: `rdwctl traffic drain --service runtime-inference --selector=canary --grace=30s`
ops-bot: Accepted command, draining. Current canary active connections: 34 -> 8 -> 0.
dmitri: Flipping flag: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://controlplane.redwood/api/flags/rl-eu --data '{"state":"off"}'`
sree: flag flipped to off for region eu-west. Confirmed via controlplane UI. :white_check_mark:
amelia: Observability: error rate dropping in eu-west to 1.2% over last 30s. latency back to baseline.
maria: Noted customer recovery. Will initiate mitigation outreach for affected accounts.
ted: Manual rollback because auto rollback didn't trigger: gonna rollback release to v20260313. Command: `rdwctl rollout rollback --service runtime-inference --to-release v20260313 --force`
dmitri: Running rollback. Watch logs: `kubectl -n inference rollout status rs/runtime-inference --watch`
ops-bot: Rollback job created. Podset scaling to previous replica counts.
amelia: Quick sanity check: sample request through the routed endpoint returns 200 and valid tokens.
sree: Also disabled the tighter per-token rate limit temporarily: `rate-limit-set --service runtime-inference --region eu-west --qps 700`
incident-bot: Noted mitigation steps in incident ticket INC-20260315-42. Attaching timeline and initial customer impact summary.
maria: I'll draft a short customer notice: what happened, who was affected, immediate mitigation, next steps.
ted: Handoff to morning oncall @sree for follow-up post-rollback verification. I'll stay available if something flaps.
dmitri: Post-rollback verification checklist: 
```
- confirm error rate <1% for 15m
- run smoke suite against 10 sample tenants
- validate rate-limiter metrics and quota adjustments
- schedule revert of temporary limit change once stable
```
amelia: All checks passing so far. Error rate at 0.6% over 10m. Smoke suite running (6/10 passed, investigating 4 failures that look infra-related, not model).
sree: 4 failures are from stale cache after rollback; purging KV cache. `redis-cli -h kv-eu FLUSHDB`
dmitri: caches cleared. Re-running smoke: 10/10 pass.
maria: Customer outreach drafted and ready, will send after legal/comm sign-off.
ted: Closing oncall shift. Leaving note: manual rollback performed due to rate-limit-induced canary failures; auto-rollback didn't trigger because probe evaluation lagged. Follow-ups: improve health probe to include 429 ratio, revisit rate-limit change rollout guardrails.
amelia: Filing follow-up RFC: `rl/inference-rate-limit-rollout-guard` with attack plan.
incident-bot: Incident downgraded to sev3. Recording timeline and owners.
ops-bot: Postmortem owner assigned: @dmitri. ETA for draft: 48h.
amelia: Thanks everyone. :pray:
